description: The dashboard terminal integration is upgraded to Hex1b 0.171.0, adding a canvas overlay scrollbar with retained command marks, a header showing workload title/working directory/progress with copy support, reorderable dock tabs with keyboard and drag/drop support, and an explicit Dark/Light terminal palette selector independent of the dashboard theme. A follow-up upgrade to Hex1b 0.172.0 further refines the scrollbar with circular command markers, improved marker hit-testing, rounded track geometry, and palette-derived colors.
name: Upgraded terminal engine with new navigation and metadata
